text:
Type: white classic wall clock
Use: telling time on a wall; kitchen, dining room, living room, home office
Style: traditional, farmhouse, classic
Materials: white molded case with a beaded inner ring, white face, black ornate hands
Colors: white, black
Shape: round case with a wide stepped rim and a fine beaded border, large black serif numerals, curvy spade hands, compact, light visual weight
Feel: classic, homey, charming, calm
Goes with: white or pastel walls, painted wood, cottage textiles; farmhouse, classic or traditional kitchens and dining rooms

product.name: SNDRUM
product.description: The clock is bordered by a classic moulded frame that makes it a beautiful decorative element in any room.
